name: Houdini MCP: Transaction
description: Safe execution boundary for AI-driven Houdini graph mutations. Takes a JSON list of structured operations (create_node / set_parms / connect_nodes / delete_node / set_display_flag / set_render_flag / cook_node / layout_children / build_node_chain), wraps them in a TransactionManager transaction, captures rollback snapshots per op, and either commits (auto_commit=true) or rolls back on the first failure (rollback_on_error=true). Operations are validated for shape before execution; dry_run skips execution and returns the validation report only. Never executes arbitrary Python — only the structured op vocabulary.
python_code:
import json
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime import houdini_runtime
from src.runtime.transaction_manager import get_transaction_manager
from src.runtime.scene_cache import get_scene_cache

class HouMCPTransactionNode(BaseNode):
    name = "Houdini MCP: Transaction"
    category = "Houdini"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.icon_path = "icons/houdini_icon.png"
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("transaction_name", "string", widget_type="text", default="txn")
        self.add_input("operations", "string", widget_type="text", default="[]")
        self.add_input("dry_run", "bool", widget_type="bool", default=False)
        self.add_input("auto_commit", "bool", widget_type="bool", default=True)
        self.add_input("rollback_on_error", "bool", widget_type="bool", default=True)
        self.add_output("transaction_id", "string")
        self.add_output("status", "string")
        self.add_output("operations_executed", "list")
        self.add_output("rollback_performed", "bool")
        self.add_output("errors", "list")
        self.add_output("graph_diff", "any")
        self.add_output("report_json", "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    def _empty_report(self, txn_id="", status="failed", error=""):
        empty_diff = {"created": [], "deleted": [], "modified": [], "cooked": [], "connections_changed": [], "flags_changed": []}
        errors = [{"op": "<input>", "error": error}] if error else []
        report = {
            "transaction_id": txn_id,
            "status": status,
            "operations_executed": [],
            "rollback_performed": False,
            "errors": errors,
            "graph_diff": empty_diff,
        }
        return {
            "transaction_id": txn_id,
            "status": status,
            "operations_executed": [],
            "rollback_performed": False,
            "errors": errors,
            "graph_diff": empty_diff,
            "report_json": json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True, default=str),
            "exec_out": True,
        }

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        name = (inputs.get("transaction_name") or "txn").strip() or "txn"
        raw_ops = inputs.get("operations")
        dry_run = bool(inputs.get("dry_run", False))
        auto_commit = bool(inputs.get("auto_commit", True))
        rollback_on_error = bool(inputs.get("rollback_on_error", True))

        # Accept either a JSON string or a live Python list (when wired from another node).
        if isinstance(raw_ops, list):
            operations = raw_ops
        else:
            text = (raw_ops or "").strip() or "[]"
            try:
                operations = json.loads(text)
            except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
                self.log_error(f"operations is not valid JSON: {exc}")
                return self._empty_report(error=f"invalid operations JSON: {exc}")
        if not isinstance(operations, list):
            self.log_error("operations must decode to a JSON list.")
            return self._empty_report(error="operations must be a list")

        validation_errors = []
        for i, op in enumerate(operations):
            err = houdini_runtime._validate_operation(op)
            if err:
                validation_errors.append({"index": i, "error": err})

        if validation_errors:
            self.log_error(f"Operation validation failed for {len(validation_errors)} op(s).")
            empty_diff = {"created": [], "deleted": [], "modified": [], "cooked": [], "connections_changed": [], "flags_changed": []}
            report = {
                "transaction_id": "",
                "status": "failed",
                "operations_executed": [],
                "rollback_performed": False,
                "errors": validation_errors,
                "graph_diff": empty_diff,
            }
            return {
                "transaction_id": "",
                "status": "failed",
                "operations_executed": [],
                "rollback_performed": False,
                "errors": validation_errors,
                "graph_diff": empty_diff,
                "report_json": json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True, default=str),
                "exec_out": True,
            }

        if dry_run:
            self.log_info(f"dry_run: {len(operations)} op(s) validated, no execution.")
            empty_diff = {"created": [], "deleted": [], "modified": [], "cooked": [], "connections_changed": [], "flags_changed": []}
            report = {
                "transaction_id": "",
                "status": "validated",
                "operations_executed": [],
                "rollback_performed": False,
                "errors": [],
                "graph_diff": empty_diff,
            }
            return {
                "transaction_id": "",
                "status": "validated",
                "operations_executed": [],
                "rollback_performed": False,
                "errors": [],
                "graph_diff": empty_diff,
                "report_json": json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True, default=str),
                "exec_out": True,
            }

        mgr = get_transaction_manager()
        cache = get_scene_cache()
        # Snapshot baseline of dirty state so the returned diff reflects only
        # what THIS transaction changed, not prior unrelated mutations.
        cache.clear_dirty_state()

        try:
            txn_id = await mgr.begin_transaction(name, metadata={"op_count": len(operations)})
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"begin_transaction failed: {exc}")
            return self._empty_report(error=f"begin failed: {exc}")

        executed = []
        first_error = None

        for i, op in enumerate(operations):
            recorded = await houdini_runtime.execute_operation(op)
            try:
                await mgr.record_operation(txn_id, recorded)
            except Exception as exc:
                first_error = f"record_operation failed at index {i}: {exc}"
                self.log_error(first_error)
                break
            executed.append({"index": i, "op": recorded.get("op"), "status": recorded.get("status")})
            if recorded.get("status") == "failed":
                first_error = recorded.get("error") or f"op '{recorded.get('op')}' failed"
                self.log_error(f"Operation {i} ({recorded.get('op')}) failed: {first_error}")
                break

        rollback_performed = False
        rollback_errors = []
        if first_error is not None:
            if rollback_on_error:
                self.log_info(f"Rolling back transaction '{txn_id}'...")
                try:
                    result = await mgr.rollback_transaction(txn_id)
                    rollback_performed = True
                    rollback_errors = result.get("rollback_errors") or []
                except Exception as exc:
                    rollback_errors = [{"op": "<rollback>", "error": str(exc)}]
                    try:
                        await mgr.mark_failed(txn_id, str(exc))
                    except Exception:
                        pass
            else:
                try:
                    await mgr.mark_failed(txn_id, first_error)
                except Exception:
                    pass
        elif auto_commit:
            try:
                await mgr.commit_transaction(txn_id)
            except Exception as exc:
                self.log_error(f"commit_transaction failed: {exc}")

        # Pull the final transaction view so the report reflects manager state.
        final = await mgr.get_transaction(txn_id) or {}
        diff = cache.get_dirty_nodes()

        all_errors = list(final.get("errors") or [])
        if rollback_errors:
            all_errors.extend(rollback_errors)

        status = final.get("status", "pending")
        if status == "committed":
            self.log_success(f"Transaction '{txn_id}' committed ({len(executed)} op(s)).")
        elif status == "rolled_back":
            self.log_info(f"Transaction '{txn_id}' rolled back.")
        elif status == "failed":
            self.log_error(f"Transaction '{txn_id}' failed (no rollback performed).")

        report = {
            "transaction_id": txn_id,
            "status": status,
            "operations_executed": executed,
            "rollback_performed": rollback_performed,
            "errors": all_errors,
            "graph_diff": diff,
        }
        return {
            "transaction_id": txn_id,
            "status": status,
            "operations_executed": executed,
            "rollback_performed": rollback_performed,
            "errors": all_errors,
            "graph_diff": diff,
            "report_json": json.dumps(report, indent=2, sort_keys=True, default=str),
            "exec_out": True,
        }

def register_node():
    return HouMCPTransactionNode
